cards.name: Ally's Call
cards.text: Starring up a Hero grants 1 random Hero(es) with at least 1 shared Synergy.

cards.name: Death Oracle
cards.text: Commander gains 35 Shield. The next up to 35 Shop refresh(es) will cost 1 HP instead.

cards.name: Premium Client II
cards.text: When you refresh the Shop, there's a 48% chance of obtaining a free Shop Refresh.

cards.name: Rising Festivities
cards.text: Gain 5 Gold. Afterward, gain 1 random Hero(es) each round costing (Commander Level -5) Gold (Min 1 Gold).

cards.name: Shield of Fortune
cards.text: Gain 10 Gold and 30 Shield of Fortune (consumed first). After 5 round(s), any remaining Shield of Fortune is converted into Gold at a 1:1 ratio.

cards.name: The More, the Merrier
cards.text: After the battle, gain 1 Gold for every 1 Synergy activated.

cards.name: Vault Upgrade
cards.text: Increase the interest limit to 8. Gain 12 Gold.

cards.name: Customize Recruitment II
cards.text: The chance of finding 4-Gold Heroes in Shop refreshes increases by 9%, while the chances for 1-, 2-, and 3-Gold Heroes decrease by 3%.

cards.name: Fast Promotion
cards.text: The next Hero you purchase costs no Gold and is instantly upgraded to 2-Star.

cards.name: Full Throttle
cards.text: Reduce EXP required to upgrade Commander Level by 15%.

cards.name: Payday
cards.text: Gain 7 Gold immediately and 7 Gold per round for the next 2 rounds.

cards.name: Premium Client I
cards.text: When you refresh the Shop, there's a 35% chance of obtaining a free Shop Refresh.

cards.name: Trust Fund
cards.text: Gain 8 / 16 / 25 Gold upon reaching Commander Lv.8 / 9 / 10, respectively.

cards.name: Customize Recruitment I
cards.text: The chance of finding 3-Gold Heroes in Shop refreshes increases by 10%, while the chances for 1- and 2-Gold Heroes decrease by 5%.

cards.name: Healing Fountain
cards.text: Restore 3 Commander HP each round, and gain 4 Gold.
